guide.rickrooms.page.0:
RICK'S FIELD GUIDE

For idiots who touch my stuff. That's you. Read it or don't, I'm not your dad.

If you die in a pocket dimension, that's on you.

- R. Sanchez
guide.rickrooms.page.1:
THE PORTAL GUN

Craft it: lime glass, an eye of ender, iron and a diamond.

Right-click: shoot a portal and walk through. Sneak + right-click: the dial. Save places, pick where you go.
guide.rickrooms.page.2:
PORTAL FLUID

Every portal burns some. A bottle, an ender pearl, a slime ball and lime dye makes more. The gun refills itself from your pockets when it runs dry.

Drops of it fling you to a saved place.
guide.rickrooms.page.3:
WARP GATEWAYS

Iron, obsidian, a diamond, eyes of ender and portal fluid. Place two, then right-click one with the gun and then the other. Now they're linked, forever. Walk in one, out the other.
guide.rickrooms.page.4:
UPGRADES

Smithing table.

Targeting + diamond: shots zap creatures through.

Blender + mantis scythe: attack mode. Press R.

DNA Lock + totem: it comes back when you die.
guide.rickrooms.page.5:
THE BACKROOMS

Fall wrong and you might noclip out of reality into Level 0. Or, smarter: find three torn journal pages in chests, add portal fluid, and program the coordinates into your gun.
guide.rickrooms.page.6:
SANITY

The Backrooms eat your mind. Dark, alone, something nearby: it drains faster. Low sanity means things that aren't there.

Almond Water fixes it. The Sunlit Lobby too.
guide.rickrooms.page.7:
GETTING AROUND DOWN THERE

Red EXIT doors lead to other levels. Pits drop you a level. A black hole in a wall throws you somewhere random.

Every level you reach, your gun remembers.
guide.rickrooms.page.8:
THE LEVELS

0 the Lobby. 1 the garage. 4 the offices. 188 the windows. The Harvest. The Wooden Hotel, over the Scaffold Void, over the Glowstone Cavern. Level 37, the Poolrooms. Level Fun.
guide.rickrooms.page.9:
THE WAY OUT

The Sunlit Lobby is safe. Nothing hunts there, your head clears, beds work, and its red doors go home.

Farmhouse doors in the Harvest lead there. So do the castles in the Cavern.
guide.rickrooms.page.10:
THE HARVEST

Scarecrows don't move while you look at them. You can't look everywhere. Listen for the corn rustling.

They freeze in torchlight. Carry a torch. Better: a Scarecrow Lantern.
guide.rickrooms.page.11:
SCARECROWS, YOURS

They drop their heads. Wear one if you're weird.

Head, two wheat, a torch, a chain: a Lantern. Hold it, they back off.

Two hay bales, a head on top: one that minds your crops.
guide.rickrooms.page.12:
THE WATCHER

It stands far off and watches. It can't hurt you. Look straight at it and it goes.

Ignore it, and it gets bored, and gets closer. Much closer. Right behind you.
guide.rickrooms.page.13:
LEVEL FUN =)

The way in: red doors in Level 1 (the garage) or Level 4 (the offices), or the Hole.

The Partygoers want you to stay. Don't. Don't hit one, and don't open every present.
guide.rickrooms.page.14:
THE POOLROOMS

Warm water, white tile, nobody. It's quiet. Too quiet? No, just quiet.

The ladder by the lounge pool goes up to a way out. The drain at the bottom of the deep one goes down.
guide.rickrooms.page.15:
THE MONOLITH

One of the towers from Level 0 came through into our world. Rare, tall, broken.

The red door in it leads back where it came from. Try /locate if you're lazy.
guide.rickrooms.page.16:
CRONENBERG WORLD

My fault. Long story. Rick's notes from chests + portal fluid = coordinates.

Everything there is flesh, and it gets into you. Cure Serum: Almond Water, a mutagen sac, a golden carrot.
guide.rickrooms.page.17:
THE COUNCIL

Somewhere in the Overworld there's a round white chamber full of other versions of your friends. They trade.

And a Microverse Battery powers furnaces forever. You're welcome.

Glass, iron blocks, a Microverse Battery. Space up, Alt down, click to shoot, V weapon, B repulsor, G portal.

THE INFINITE IKEA

A store that never ends, with everything in it. Crates refill every morning. Day: the staff ignore you. Night: run. A Staff Badge fools them.

The EXIT signs lie, until you're near a checkout.

guide.rickrooms.page.20:
THE DEAD MALL

Two floors of empty shops round skylit courts. Nobody's here. Nobody's been here for years.

A few doors at the back of the shops, and in the big stores, still lead somewhere.
advancements.rickrooms.endless_field.des: Find the field that goes on forever
guide.rickrooms.page.21:
THE ENDLESS FIELD

Grass and sky. It never gets later. Your head doesn't get worse here. Or better.

A door standing on its own goes home. The hole with the stairs goes down.

STILL LIFES, OF US

It copies people too. It gets them wrong. Too tall. Too many faces. Too many hands. Faces in planks.

They wear your skin. They stand still until you're close. Then they don't.

pet.rickrooms.cat.fitted.0: Finally. Someone noticed I was the smart one all along.
pet.rickrooms.cat.fitted.1: Ah. So this is what thinking feels like. You, %1$s, are bad at it.
pet.rickrooms.cat.idle.0: I knocked your cup off the table as a social experiment. Results: inconclusive.
pet.rickrooms.cat.idle.1: I could solve all your problems, %1$s. I simply choose not to.
pet.rickrooms.cat.idle.2: Nine lives, and I have to spend this one with you.
pet.rickrooms.cat.idle.3: I sit in boxes because they are geometrically superior. Obviously.
pet.rickrooms.cat.idle.4: Your bed is mine now. I've filed the paperwork.
pet.rickrooms.cat.idle.5: Don't mistake my napping for a lack of ambition.
pet.rickrooms.cat.attack.0: Ugh. Fine. I'll do it myself.
pet.rickrooms.cat.kill.0: That was beneath me. Literally, it's on the floor now.
pet.rickrooms.cat.kill.1: I'll be leaving that on your pillow.
pet.rickrooms.bird.fitted.0: Squawk! Wait. Squawk is a word? I know WORDS!
pet.rickrooms.bird.fitted.1: I just read every book you own, %1$s. They were mostly about potatoes.
pet.rickrooms.bird.idle.1: I've stopped repeating things. Mostly. Mostly. Mostly.
pet.rickrooms.bird.idle.2: From up here I can see all your mistakes, %1$s.
pet.rickrooms.bird.idle.3: Did you know I'm basically a tiny dinosaur? With a helmet!
pet.rickrooms.bird.idle.4: I've composed a symphony. It's three notes. They're all squawks.
pet.rickrooms.bird.idle.5: Crackers are a gateway snack. I see that now.
pet.rickrooms.fox.fitted.0: Oh, this is going to be fun. For me, mostly.
pet.rickrooms.fox.fitted.1: Clever was already my whole thing, %1$s. Now I'm unstoppable.
pet.rickrooms.fox.idle.0: I've hidden seventeen of your things. It's a puzzle. You'll love it.
pet.rickrooms.fox.idle.1: What does the fox say? Mostly philosophy, these days.
pet.rickrooms.fox.idle.2: I trust you, %1$s. Don't make me regret it.
pet.rickrooms.fox.idle.4: Every berry bush for a mile is mine. I keep records.
pet.rickrooms.fox.idle.5: I could rob a bank. I won't. Probably.
pet.rickrooms.fox.attack.0: Sneak attack! ...less sneaky now that I'm shouting.
pet.rickrooms.fox.kill.1: Should've seen that coming. I did.
pet.rickrooms.horse.fitted.0: Neigh-- no. No more neighing. Hello, %1$s.
pet.rickrooms.horse.fitted.1: You've been SITTING on me this whole time? We need to talk.
pet.rickrooms.horse.idle.0: Do you know how heavy you are, %1$s? Because I do.
pet.rickrooms.horse.idle.1: I run fast so you don't have to. A thank-you would be nice.
pet.rickrooms.horse.idle.2: Hay again? I have a sophisticated palate now.
pet.rickrooms.horse.idle.3: One day, a horse will ride a human. I'm just saying.
pet.rickrooms.horse.idle.4: I've worked out the shortest path to the nearest carrot. It's in your pocket.
pet.rickrooms.horse.idle.5: My ancestors pulled carts. I'm pulling off this helmet.
pet.rickrooms.horse.kill.0: That's what you get for standing behind me.
pet.rickrooms.horse.kill.1: Neigh-ver again. Sorry, I couldn't resist.
pet.rickrooms.llama.fitted.0: Oh good. Now I can spit with PRECISION.
pet.rickrooms.llama.fitted.1: Greetings, %1$s. I have opinions about the carpets you put on me.
pet.rickrooms.llama.idle.0: I don't spit at people I respect. You're on thin ice, %1$s.
pet.rickrooms.llama.idle.1: Being a pack animal is just a gig job with fur.
pet.rickrooms.llama.idle.2: I am fluffy AND intelligent. Fear me.
pet.rickrooms.llama.idle.3: Traders have been underpaying llamas for centuries.
pet.rickrooms.llama.idle.4: Llama? Drama? I'm above both now.
pet.rickrooms.llama.idle.5: My wool is excellent and my thoughts are better.
pet.rickrooms.llama.attack.0: Spitting at the speed of sound!
pet.rickrooms.llama.kill.0: Spat on. Defeated. In that order.
pet.rickrooms.pet.fitted.0: I... I can THINK! What a time to be alive, %1$s!
pet.rickrooms.pet.fitted.1: Hello. I appear to be a genius now.
pet.rickrooms.pet.idle.0: I've been thinking a lot lately. It's new.
pet.rickrooms.pet.idle.1: Do you ever wonder what's past the render distance, %1$s?
pet.rickrooms.pet.idle.2: My brain is the size of a planet. My helmet is the size of my head.
pet.rickrooms.pet.idle.3: I'm learning so much. Mostly about you. Some of it's concerning.
pet.rickrooms.pet.idle.4: Is this what Ricks feel like all the time? No wonder they drink.
pet.rickrooms.pet.idle.5: Sometimes I forget I'm a genius. Then I remember. It's great.
pet.rickrooms.pet.owner_hurt.2: You're bleeding, %1$s! That's the red stuff, right? That's bad?
pet.rickrooms.pet.low_health.0: I'm hurt, %1$s. A treat would help. Medically.
pet.rickrooms.pet.low_health.1: This helmet doesn't cover the rest of me!
pet.rickrooms.pet.warning.0: Heads up, %1$s, something nasty is coming.
pet.rickrooms.pet.warning.1: Hostile incoming! Put the snacks down.
pet.rickrooms.pet.warning.2: I'm detecting a monster. Also your fly's open. Kidding. The monster's real.
pet.rickrooms.pet.creeper.1: Green, hissing, about to explode. RUN!
pet.rickrooms.pet.creeper.2: Creeper! And I'm smart enough NOT to bite that one.
pet.rickrooms.pet.heal_owner.1: Patching you up. Don't tell anyone I'm a doctor now.
pet.rickrooms.pet.fetch.1: Found these lying around. You're welcome.
pet.rickrooms.pet.fetch.2: I fetched. Not because I'm a pet. Because I'm helpful.
pet.rickrooms.pet.module.0: Ooh, a new module. I can feel it in my wires.
pet.rickrooms.pet.module.2: Is it me, or did I just get cooler?
pet.rickrooms.pet.removed.0: Wait, I was just about to work out the meaning of l- ...treat?
pet.rickrooms.pet.removed.2: Fine. Back to being adorable and simple.
pet.rickrooms.pet.death.0: Tell the other pets... I was smart...
pet.rickrooms.pet.death.1: Goodbye, %1$s. Give my helmet to someone worthy.
pet.rickrooms.pet.death.2: It was a good run. Mostly running.
pet.rickrooms.pet.night.0: It's dark. I can see in the dark. Can you? Ha.
pet.rickrooms.pet.night.1: The stars are just faraway suns, %1$s. Anyway. Goodnight.
pet.rickrooms.pet.night.2: Night is monster time. Stay close.

guide.rickrooms.page.25:
THE ABANDONED CITY

A whole city. Nobody in it. Not a dog, not a bird. The trees are winning.

Some flats still have a red door in the front entrance. One way out of the dead mall leads here.

guide.rickrooms.page.26:
DROP LIMIT

Islands of grass over a sea of cloud. The roads run off the edges. Read the signs.

Clouds don't hold you up. Step off and you sink right through, and fall somewhere worse.
guide.rickrooms.page.27:
THE FACADE

One wall. Windows and air conditioners, up and down into the fog, forever.

Walk the ledges, climb the ladders, cross the catwalks. Some windows are open. Some rooms have a red door.
guide.rickrooms.page.28:
THE STAIRCASE

Stairs in the sky, going every way at once. Landings, arches, more stairs.

The doors in the arches mostly lead to Drop Limit. Fall, and you end up there anyway.
guide.rickrooms.page.29:
FROOPYLAND

I made it for Beth. Soft ground, bouncy, nobody gets hurt. The river's breathable. Your head clears here.

Doors in the grass go home. Don't go in the hole. Tommy's hole.
guide.rickrooms.page.30:
RUN FOR YOUR LIFE

A maze of halls. Red light. Something behind you the second you arrive.

Don't stop. Pick a way at the forks. Some dead ends have the one door that opens. Some don't.
